jobs.description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at .

As an outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Bitwarden, you will play a pivotal role as a Product Specialist, acting as the first point of contact for potential customers. Your responsibilities will include developing a deep understanding of our sales process, researching leads, initiating new relationships, and setting the stage for our sales team's success. You will engage primarily in outbound sales activities, showcasing our offerings compellingly through various channels.

This position is open to candidates currently residing anywhere within the UK.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Generate sales leads by effectively prospecting and engaging potential Mid-Market and Enterprise clients through outbound outreach.
  • Manage and maintain an outbound sales pipeline, ensuring optimal lead and prospect qualification.
  • Identify and respond to potential client’s needs and suggest appropriate solutions.
  • Follow the sales playbook to guide sales leads through an Account Executive-led buying process.
  • Adhere to service-level agreements on lead outreach and follow-up intervals.

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 2+ years of outbound sales experience as a Sales Development Representative in the technology / SaaS space.
  • Experience using a CRM tool such as HubSpot, Outreach, or a similar engagement tool.
  • Experience using prospecting tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar, particularly in Enterprise B2B environments.
  • Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to quickly articulate technical information concisely.
  • Effective problem-solving abilities, coupled with strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Innovative thinker who thrives in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Collaborative team player willing to share best practices and learn from others.
  • Demonstrates persistence, resilience, and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • A 4-year degree or equivalent is preferred.

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team
  • Interview with SDR Manager
  • SDR Skills Assessment
  • Interview with Head of Enablement
  • References

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us, and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open-source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world and take part in productive and fun meetups.
  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

jobs.excerpt: Job PurposeAs the Senior Director of Global Pricing, you will be a pivotal leader in RWS's strategic transformation into a tech‑based commercial organization.
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

As the Senior Director of Global Pricing, you will be a pivotal leader in RWS's strategic transformation into a tech‑based commercial organization. Reporting directly to executive leadership, you will spearhead our evolution from traditional service-based models to a unified, recurring revenue framework built on SaaS and consumption-based pricing.

This role is highly collaborative, requiring deep engagement with senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design and embed a holistic pricing ecosystem spanning our Generate, Transform, and Protect pillars. You will be the primary driver in executing a strategy that intelligently bundles our proprietary technology and world-class services—accelerating high‑margin, scalable growth and empowering our global sales force through advanced CPQ automation.

Success in this role hinges on your ability to build trusted partnerships, influence diverse senior audiences, and create alignment across global teams as we navigate significant commercial transformation.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing & Offer Design

  • Lead the business model transformation from transactional pricing to subscription and consumption-based models that capture the full value of our offerings
  • Develop sophisticated pricing for integrated Tech + Service offers, architecting solutions at the intersection of our proprietary AI-driven technology and premier human-in-the-loop services
  • Drive the strategic overhaul of the Trados product portfolio, transitioning from a legacy license‑and‑maintenance structure to a modern, multi-tiered SaaS model that maximizes ACV and accelerates subscription adoption
  • Define and iterate pricing for new, high-growth ventures—such as AI Dubbing—ensuring commercially compelling models that support rapid global expansion
  • Collaborate closely with Product, GTM, and Finance leaders to ensure pricing strategies are co‑created, aligned, and scalable across regions and customer segments
  • Engage stakeholders early in design cycles to build buy‑in and ensure pricing models are understood, adopted, and reinforced throughout the organisation

CPQ Digital Transformation

  • Architect and drive the enterprise-wide CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) digital transformation, creating a unified system across all commercial pillars
  • Empower the global sales organization to autonomously generate complex, high‑value quotes combining software subscriptions, API usage, and tiered service credits
  • Design and implement intelligent, automated approval workflows to eliminate "Deal Desk" friction and dramatically improve commercial velocity
  • Partner with Sales Operations, IT, and Regional Leadership to ensure CPQ capabilities reflect real-world needs and deliver a seamless user experience
  • Facilitate cross-functional working groups to maintain alignment, resolve competing priorities, and secure commitment to system adoption

Commercial Enablement & Deal Engineering

  • Act as the senior strategic partner for enterprise-level global bids, engineering deal structures that embed our unique technology value and secure long-term, profitable relationships
  • Develop self-service commercial modelling tools within the CRM, enabling sales teams to model and present compelling pricing scenarios in real-time
  • Maintain a constant pulse on the competitive landscape to ensure RWS’s pricing and value proposition remain market-leading
  • Engage executive stakeholders to navigate strategic trade-offs, gain approvals, and align pricing decisions with broader corporate objectives

Skills & Experience

  • B2B Tech/SaaS Experience: Demonstratable experience in a senior Pricing, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Strategy role within B2B SaaS or Tech‑Enabled Services
  • Transformational Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead a traditional sales organization through cultural and operational shifts
  • CPQ Architecture: Proven experience architecting and leading a large-scale CPQ implementation (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, DealHub) in a complex, hybrid software-and-services business.
  • Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Deep expertise in pricing new technology, restructuring legacy portfolios, and modeling complex revenue scenarios
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Skilled at building cross-functional partnerships, aligning diverse teams behind a unified commercial vision, facilitating decision-making in complex environments and influencing at C‑suite and senior leadership levels

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

Summary

Fire Creek Services Company, an All Native Group company, is seeking a Data / BI Analyst to build performance dashboards and monthly performance reports for facility maintenance operations (resolution time, first-time fix, emergency response, preventive maintenance compliance, parts fill rate, data completeness and customer satisfaction), along with failure and lifecycle analyses that guide improvement.   • Define performance baselines, calculation rules and exclusions with the Government customer, and report by request priority, asset class and zone.
  • Build and maintain operational dashboards that show source timestamps and data sync status.
  • Produce monthly performance and cost-avoidance reports.
  • Analyze failure codes and repeat visits, and support parts-demand planning using historical work-request data.
  • Validate data for accuracy, completeness and timeliness before publishing reports.
  • Document metric definitions, calculation rules and data sources in a data dictionary.
  • Protect sensitive data and follow data privacy and controlled unclassified information (CUI) handling practices.

Job Summary

Senior Interoperability Architect, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP)

Job Summary:

Aptive seeks a Senior Interoperability Architect to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will develop, refine, and maintain the interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, and profiles, that define how Veteran health information moves between VistA/CPRS, the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), the Department of Defense, and community providers. The role supports the Interoperability specialty area, including the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), FHIR standards innovation, standards-based interfaces, and national exchange frameworks. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside interoperability specialists, terminologists, and VA Business Owners.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Interoperability Specifications. Develop, refine, and maintain interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, profiles, and implementation guides, for VA exchange use cases.
  • Standards Analysis. Analyze industry standards, VHA business requirements, and relevant technological innovation to recommend specification approaches.
  • HL7 and FHIR Design. Design solutions using HL7 V2, C-CDA, and FHIR, including FHIR profiles and API specifications that extend VA’s use of standards-based APIs.
  • Community Care and Partner Exchange. Define specifications that support exchange with community care providers, the Department of Defense, and other partners, aligned to national exchange frameworks.
  • Device and System Interfaces. Develop standards-based specifications for device and system interfaces that support the Federal EHR.
  • Discovery Projects. Lead discovery and prototyping for new standards needs, such as consent management and time zone interoperability.
  • Conformance and Adoption. Define conformance criteria and testing approaches, and track adoption of standards across VA systems and exchange partners.
  • Federal Policy Alignment. Align specifications with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework, USCDI, and applicable federal interoperability policy.
  • Architecture Runway Collaboration. Contribute interoperability architecture inputs to OCI’s Architecture Runway Collaborative and to cross-team dependency reviews.
  • Agile Team Participation. Participate in Planning Interval (PI) Planning, backlog refinement, iteration ceremonies, and system demos; help decompose Epics into Features with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Technical Guidance and Briefings. Provide technical guidance to analysts and informaticists, and present architecture recommendations to OCI leadership and VA Business Owners.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in standards development, adoption, and conformance.
  • Experience developing, refining, or maintaining interoperability specifications, such as standards, data models, profiles, or implementation guides.
  • Familiarity with HL7 specifications, including V2, C-CDA, and FHIR.
  • Familiarity with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework and related federal interoperability policies.
  • Experience analyzing industry standards and business requirements to design interoperability solutions.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization.

  • HL7 FHIR Proficiency or another HL7 certification.
  • Experience authoring FHIR implementation guides, participating in HL7 workgroups, or sponsoring ballots.
  • Experience with national exchange frameworks, such as eHealth Exchange, Carequality, CommonWell, or TEFCA.
  • Experience with FHIR conformance testing tools, such as Inferno, Touchstone, or the HL7 FHIR Validator.
  • Experience with VA systems, such as VistA/CPRS, VHIE, JLV, or VA Lighthouse APIs, or with the Federal EHR (Oracle Health).
  • Experience on SAFe or Scrum teams.

jobs.excerpt: Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company.
jobs.description:
Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior QA engineer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp. is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll test across multiple client projects, each with its own platform, users, and quirks. You'll need to understand a new platform quickly and see it the way its end users do: what they expect, where they get confused, and what breaks when they do something nobody planned for.

We ship weekly, from development to staging to production. You'll be the quality gate in between. That includes regression testing: running the same core flows release after release, carefully, every time. If repetition bores you, this isn't the right fit. If you see it as the job that protects users, it is.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast, and it makes QA more important, not less. We expect you to use AI to generate test cases, draft scripts, and speed up automation, and to know where it falls short: an AI-written test can pass while missing the bug a real user would hit. You need to judge whether a test actually proves something. If you can only run the tests an AI wrote for you, this isn't the role for you.

You'll work closely with developers and project managers, and you'll keep moving our testing forward by adopting new automation tools as they appear. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

  • Test new features and bug fixes across multiple client projects before they reach production
  • Run regression testing on core user flows for every release
  • Write clear test cases and test scripts based on acceptance criteria
  • Build and maintain automated tests using modern tools, including AI-powered testing tools
  • Report bugs with precise reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and evidence
  • Evaluate features from the end user's perspective and flag usability issues, not only functional ones
  • Work independently while keeping the team informed

We're looking for a self-starter who organizes their own day. We trust you to prioritize your week and keep everyone updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

  • Fluent Spanish
  • Advanced English (able to discuss issues with the team and clients)

Technical

  • 2+ years of full-time QA experience
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to learn new platforms quickly
  • Experience writing test cases and test scripts
  • Basic technical background: browser developer tools, API testing (e.g., Postman), and basic scripting in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright or Cypress
  • Experience using AI tools in daily work, including for QA (test generation, test case design, automation)
  • Experience with issue trackers (we use Linear)
  • Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

  • Experience testing healthcare or other regulated software
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Fluent English (B2+)
  • Strong written and oral communication

What we offer

  • Fully remote: work from home or anywhere you choose
  • Competitive pay: rates that compete with the best in the Latin American market, tailored to your seniority and skills, paid in the currency you prefer
  • Crypto payment available on request
  • Full-time contractor: you manage your own finances
  • Flexible hours: we work across time zones and trust you to get your work done on your schedule
  • Company culture: no rigid hierarchy; hard work and enjoying the journey are not in conflict
  • Gaming: online games with colleagues over Discord is a regular thing here
  • Broad technical exposure: many platforms and challenges in a short time; you won't get bored in the same project
  • International clients: US, Canada, Germany, and beyond, with the languages and cultures that come with them
  • Professional development: sponsored online courses and certifications on demand
  • Career development: build expertise across industries, not only in testing

Interested?

If this sounds like you and you meet the minimum requirements, apply.

Marketing Operations Specialist
Remote-First | Early-Career Opportunity | AI-First Environment

Do you enjoy uncovering why two reports do not match, why a campaign suddenly stopped generating quality leads, or how a repetitive process could be improved using AI and automation?
Basement Kings USA is seeking a technically curious, analytical, and highly organized Marketing Operations Specialist to connect leadership, advertising agencies, marketing platforms, customer data, and multiple operating brands. This is not a social-media or content-creation position. The role focuses on making sure marketing operations work effectively through paid-media oversight, data analysis, tracking, agency accountability, and AI-enabled process improvement.

Position Details
Reports To: Chief Marketing Officer
Location: Remote in Durham, NC
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-6:00pm EST
Compensation: $62,000-$72,000 per year, depending on experience
Travel: Occasional business travel may be required

What You'll Own
Paid-Media Performance
Work directly in Google Ads and other paid-media platforms while also overseeing agency-managed accounts. Review campaign structure, bids, budgets, keywords, competition, conversion data, ad quality, and automated bidding to evaluate performance and ask informed questions.
Data, Customer Insights & Measurement
Analyze and reconcile information across advertising platforms, call tracking, analytics, CRM data, internal reports, and agency reporting. Research discrepancies, identify patterns in lead quality and customer behavior, and turn findings into recommended tests, operational changes, or budget decisions.
Agency & Marketing Operations
Coordinate with paid-media and SEO agencies, document commitments, confirm completed work, and follow open items through resolution. Support platform access, invoices, billing questions, vendor administration, and operating documentation.
Tracking & Systems
Monitor connections between systems such as CallRail, GA4, Google Ads, Zapier, and ServiceTitan. Spot broken tracking, unreliable conversion data, duplicate records, or incomplete data that could affect campaign performance and automated bidding.
AI & Automation
Use AI to build or meaningfully improve workflows, automations, agents, lightweight applications, scripts, reporting processes, or other repeatable systems. AI output must be verified, with the employee remaining accountable for accuracy and final results.

Foundational Skills

  • 2-3 years of related experience in marketing operations, paid media, analytics, business operations, or a combination of these areas.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads or a comparable paid-media platform and working knowledge of PPC/paid-search mechanics.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data cleaning, and reconciliation.
  • Experience building or improving an AI-enabled workflow, automation, agent, application, script, or repeatable process.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and the ability to research conflicting data.
  • Clear written communication and confidence working with agencies, vendors, leadership, and internal partners.
  • Ability to work independently, learn new systems quickly, and remain accountable in a remote-first environment.
Helpful Experience
Experience with any of these systems is valuable but hands-on experience and demonstrated problem-solving ability matter more than knowing every platform or holding certifications
  • GA4,
  • CallRail
  • ServiceTitan
  • Zapier
  • Google Business Profile

  • Local Services Ads
  • Meta Ads
  • APIs, SQL, Google Apps Script, BI tools
  • No-code or AI-assisted development platforms

  • Enjoy investigating data until you understand why numbers do not match.

  • Look for opportunities to turn successful one-time solutions into repeatable systems.

Within the first 90 days, you will begin taking ownership of agency coordination, assigned paid-media responsibilities, tracking-health checks, data reconciliation, cross-brand standards, and routine vendor administration. You will also implement or significantly improve at least one AI-assisted workflow and present at least one data-supported recommendation for a campaign test, budget decision, process improvement, or cross-brand change.

Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a Knowledge Center Team Lead to supervise a team of Tier I Knowledge Center (KC) agents supporting the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the KC through a dedicated toll-free number, support email, public web form, and public chatbot, and the KC agent creates and manages the ticket on their behalf. The Team Lead owns real-time team performance against SLAs and XLAs, coaches agents on external-user handling and manual ticket creation, enforces the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and coordinates escalations to application resolver groups. The Team Lead also owns the handoff between the external-facing KC and the internal application resolver groups that support the mission. External users cannot see internal systems, so when a Tier I KC agent cannot resolve an issue, the Team Lead determines the correct resolver group, ensures the ticket is complete and correctly prioritized, tracks it to resolution, and manages communication back to the external user through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This role analyzes escalation patterns to reduce future escalations and is the KC's senior technical resource for complex application issues. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Supervise a team of Tier I service desk and Knowledge Center analysts across core hours (6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET) and extended-hours shifts, including scheduling, coverage planning, attendance, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
  • Own real-time and daily operational performance: monitor contact volumes, queue health, ticket aging, First Contact Resolution, Tier 0 deflection, and PL1-PL4 SLA adherence, and take corrective action to keep open tickets exceeding resolution SLA within the acceptable quality level.
  • Enforce the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and ticket documentation standards through a structured quality assurance program, including ticket audits, call and chat reviews, and calibrated feedback.
  • Lead the service desk's response to PL1/PL2 critical incidents, including communications, situational awareness alerts, and coordination with Tier II, endpoint, communications, and application resolver groups.
  • Analyze escalated external-user tickets to determine the correct application resolver group, required information, and Priority Level, and manage seamless, documented handoffs while retaining ownership of the customer outcome.
  • Track escalated tickets against PL1-PL4 resolution SLAs, drive follow-up with resolver groups, and manage external-user communication and the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process.
  • Serve as the KC's senior technical resource for complex application issues (account, access, role, workflow, and data issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications), resolving what can be resolved within KC authority.
  • Analyze escalation drivers by application, recommend knowledge articles, chatbot content, and process changes that reduce escalations, and contribute to Problem Resolution Action Plans and the CX Roadmap.
  • Serve as the senior technical decision-maker within Tier I, analyzing the most complex incidents and service requests to determine root cause and business impact, and deciding resolution strategy, priority, and escalation across Tier II, Tier III, and specialized resolver groups.
  • Own team-level queue management decisions: assess real-time contact volumes and ticket aging, rebalance work across analysts, and direct actions to protect PL1-PL4 SLAs, First Contact Resolution targets, and the acceptable quality level for aged tickets.
  • Design and administer the Tier I quality assurance review process, evaluating tickets and customer interactions against standards, enforcing the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and determining coaching and corrective actions for analysts.
  • Lead analysis of Tier 0/I trend and escalation data to identify recurring and high-impact problems, and prepare After-Action Reviews, Root Cause Analyses, and Problem Resolution Action Plans with recommended permanent solutions.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 1 year of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). 7 total years (education/experience) required.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in enterprise IT service desk, help desk, or end-user support, including experience as a lead or senior analyst.
  • Expert troubleshooting skills across Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, network connectivity, VPN, printers, mobile devices, and common enterprise applications.
  • Extensive experience with an enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow), including reporting, knowledge management, and queue management.
  • Demonstrated experience improving First Contact Resolution, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction through process, knowledge, and coaching initiatives.
  • Experience performing ticket quality reviews, mentoring analysts, and delivering training.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts if assigned to the extended-hours team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief supervisors and Government stakeholders on performance and trends.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • HDI Support Center Team Lead, HDI Desktop Support Technician, or ITIL 4 Foundation / Practitioner certification.
  • Experience using ServiceNow (incident, request, knowledge, CMDB, Service Catalog, Virtual Agent) or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
  • Experience working across multiple security enclaves (NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS) and with classified system handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with customer experience (CX) measurement, including CSAT, Customer Effort Score (CES), and experience level agreements (XLAs).
  • Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or other compliance-driven Federal IT environments.
  • Experience with AI-enabled service desk capabilities (ServiceNow Virtual Agent, AI Ops, predictive analytics) and measuring Tier 0 deflection.
  • Experience contributing to Problem Management, Root Cause Analysis, and continuous improvement programs.

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. WSP is seeking a Senior Transmission Line Project Manager for our Power & Energy Management Team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technical, schedules, quality, and financial aspects of Power and Energy Transmission Line projects, managing and developing client relationships, and marketing WSP’s Power Delivery services to existing and new clients, particularly in the South and Southwest Region. This position will be based out of Houston, TX, Austin, TX or Fort Worth, TX with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Transmission Line projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

  • Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and EHV Transmission Line projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
  • Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
  • Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.

  • Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
  • Manage and provide performance guidance and leadership to assigned staff.
  • Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
  • Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
  • Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
  • Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
  • Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
  • Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Engineering, Construction Management or other related field within the Power & Energy Market.
  • 12+years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry
  • Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading engineering and/or construction teams on medium to large electrical utility scale clients for high voltage and/or extra high voltage transmission line type projects.
  • Knowledge and experience with project management processes and tools required, including:
    • Contract Management
    • External and Internal Team Meeting Management
    • Earned Value Management
    • Change Management
    • Risk Management
    • Schedule Management (this includes experience with CPM project schedules such as Primavera P6 or equivalent
    • Financial Management
  • Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process within the Power Delivery/Utility industry and strong background and experience in project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with critical thinking and problem-solving skills to make assessments and calculations involving the application of project management principles, with a sound understanding of intent, impact, and optimal outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
  • Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to support the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Volcano Hazards Program (VHP). In this role, you will serve as an embedded technical contributor within the VHP government team, designing, developing, documenting, and deploying a modern, cloud-ready database and associated data visualization tools that support the program’s monitoring and evaluation (M&E) workflows. Your work will directly enable scientists, program managers, and stakeholders across the five U.S. volcano observatories and the Volcano Disaster Assistance Program (VDAP) to track performance, visualize geospatial hazard data, and produce evidence-based reports.

Work Location: Remote

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Database Design & Development — Analyze government-furnished M&E plans and existing VDAP M&E database code; design and implement a relational database (PostgreSQL/PostGIS) supporting VHP monitoring and evaluation data; develop stored procedures, views, data validation logic, and comprehensive data dictionaries; architect the database for mobile device accessibility.
  • API & Backend Development — Design and implement RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI or Flask) to expose database functionality; develop data ingestion tools and ETL workflows to load M&E data from existing sources; implement metadata management aligned with USGS standards; conduct unit and integration testing of all backend components.
  • Front-End & Visualization Development — Develop a web-based and mobile-friendly data entry and reporting interface using JavaScript/TypeScript and React; create an easily editable content management tool allowing VHP staff to update the M&E framework without developer intervention; build interactive dashboards and visualization modules for M&E analysis and reporting with filtering, drill-down, and export capabilities.

jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in cloud and hybrid computing environments to support the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) at the U.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in cloud and hybrid computing environments to support the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) at the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS). In this senior-level role, you will serve as a key technical advisor and hands-on administrator across a complex hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises data center environments and multi-cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

Work location: Remote

What You Will Do:

  • Hybrid Systems Administration: Administer and maintain Windows Server and Linux/UNIX-based operating systems (Red Hat, Ubuntu, macOS, and comparable distributions) running on enterprise hardware including Dell, HP x86, and Oracle SPARC platforms across multiple physical data centers.
  • Virtualization Management: Administer VMware vCloud, vSphere, vCenter, and Enterprise Plus virtualization environments; manage VMware Operations (vROPS) and Log Insight for performance monitoring, optimization, and troubleshooting; support System Center Virtual Machine Manager (SCVMM) as needed.
  • Cloud Administration & Optimization: Administer and optimize AWS environments (EC2, S3, CloudFormation, Application Migration Service, and related services); provide expert guidance on cloud and cluster computing architectures; research, evaluate, and deploy advanced cloud computing capabilities and large-data analytics solutions for the program.
  • Migration & Modernization: Lead and support data integration and workload migration efforts from on-premises infrastructure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP); document migration paths, develop runbooks, and execute cutovers with minimal-to-no customer downtime.
  • Storage & Backup/DR Administration: Administer NAS and SAN storage devices; manage enterprise backup software; implement and maintain Backup-to-Cloud replication and disaster recovery (DR) solutions to meet program continuity requirements.
  • Architecture Advisory: Advise OCIO leadership and program stakeholders on cloud and hybrid computing architectures, system and memory management optimization across distributed platforms, and best practices for workload placement and resource utilization.
  • Security & Patch Management: Apply OS, hypervisor, and application-level security patches to resolve vulnerabilities; maintain compliance with DOI/USGS security standards and Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) remediation timelines.
  • Monitoring, Observability & Incident Response: Design and maintain operational monitoring dashboards (vROPS, Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable tools) for CPU, memory, and storage utilization; troubleshoot and resolve performance and availability incidents across physical, virtual, and cloud infrastructure.
  • DevOps & Automation Support: Leverage container and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Jenkins, Ansible, or comparable platforms) to support workload modernization, CI/CD pipeline operations, and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration records, migration plans, and runbooks; collaborate using Government-provided tools (Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams).

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience, or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience, or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States
  • Extensive experience in systems administration across hybrid IT environments (on-premises + cloud).
  • VMware Virtualization: Demonstrated expertise administering vCenter, ESXi/vSphere (6.x/7.x/8.x), vROPS, and VMware Log Insight in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • AWS Cloud Services: Hands-on experience with EC2, S3, CloudFormation, and workload migration tooling (e.g., Application Migration Service); ability to design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting production workloads.
  • Windows & Linux/UNIX: Proficiency administering Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) and Linux/UNIX environments (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu) in enterprise or Federal settings.
  • Enterprise Storage: Experience managing NAS, SAN, and enterprise hardware platforms from Dell, HP, NetApp, or comparable vendors.
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery: Working knowledge of enterprise backup and replication solutions; experience designing or implementing Backup-to-Cloud and DR strategies.
  • Multi-Cloud Environments: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, and GCP; ability to advise on workload placement, cost optimization, and architecture trade-offs.
  • Identity & Access Management: Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, PKI, and enterprise IAM.
  • Zero-Downtime Operations: Demonstrated ability to perform zero-downtime upgrades, migrations, and hardware decommissions in production environments.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; ability to produce technical documentation and present to technical peers and senior leadership.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Enterprise Architecture or a related technical field is strongly preferred
  • AWS Certification: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or equivalent AWS certification.
  • VMware Certification: VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV or VCP-VCF) or equivalent VMware certification.
  • Kubernetes & Containers: Experience with Kubernetes (on-premises, AWS, or bare metal) and container orchestration for production workloads.
  • DevOps Tooling: Jenkins (CI/CD), Ansible (configuration management/automation), or comparable pipeline tools.
  • Monitoring Platforms: Datadog, Splunk, Elasticsearch, or VMware Log Insight for enterprise observability.
  • PaaS Platforms: Exposure to Pivotal Cloud Foundry or comparable PaaS platforms in enterprise or multi-cloud environments.
  • Federal/USGS Experience: Prior support of USGS, DOI, or other Federal OCIO environments; familiarity with CHS (Cloud Hosting Solutions) infrastructure.
  • Agile/Scrum: Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or comparable Agile certification; experience working in sprint-based delivery models.
  • AI/Cloud-Native Capabilities: AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Generative AI credentials, or hands-on experience with cloud-native AI/ML services.
  • Oracle on Linux: Experience with Oracle databases on KVM/Red Hat Linux or comparable enterprise database infrastructure.
  • Team Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring junior technical staff in a professional IT environment.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Job Title: In-Home Health - Physician (Part Time)- Hartford, CT

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

  • Able to cover the following primary locations: Hartford and surrounding area.

A day in the life:

The Director of GTM, Partnerships is a mid to senior-level role at the center of Power Digital's Partnerships team, responsible for translating the partner ecosystem (Tech, PE and Advisors) into measurable commercial value. This person owns the full commercial lifecycle across our partner go-to-market. This is a highly cross-functional, enterprise-facing role that requires equal parts relationship builder, strategic operator, and financial thinker. You will manage complex fundraising motions, own commercial revenue streams from ideation to negotiation, and serve as the bridge between partners and Power Digital's internal product, sales, CX, and marketing teams.

This role reports directly to the VP of Partnerships.

Responsibilities:

Joint GTM with the Partner Ecosystem

  • Lead new partner vetting and due diligence—evaluating whether technology solutions are the right fit for Power Digital clients based on performance data, ICP alignment, and commercial potential.
  • Develop and manage joint business plans (JBPs) with priority technology and channel partners, translating shared goals into defined initiatives, timelines, and revenue targets.
  • Own and structure commercial agreements, including co-selling arrangements, resell and white-label opportunities, and bonus media incentive programs.
  • Source and activate alpha and beta opportunities with platform partners to give Power Digital a competitive first-mover advantage for clients.

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize GTM processes and partner engagement workflows.
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to the Partnerships function.

Fusepoint Partnerships

  • Develop and grow a portfolio of technology partnerships specifically designed to support fusepoint, Power Digital's measurement and strategic consulting practice.
  • Identify and structure partnerships that unlock exclusive testing opportunities, platform performance consulting engagements, referral programs, and client-facing competitive advantages.
  • Source credentialing and certification opportunities with platform partners that elevate FusePoint's credibility and market position.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for FusePoint's partner ecosystem, ensuring alignment between partner capabilities and FusePoint priorities.

Joint Technical Innovation (nova)

  • Develop and manage partnerships with technology companies aimed at co-developing nova capabilities, offsetting the product roadmap, or providing exclusive access to AI/data insights and tooling.
  • Own the full sales cycle for joint technical planning (JTP) initiatives—from opportunity identification and stakeholder alignment through proposal development, negotiation, and signed agreement.
  • Partner closely with Power Digital's product and engineering teams to ensure external partnership opportunities are aligned to the Nova roadmap and technically viable.
  • Execute a highly complex, enterprise fundraising motion—including financial modeling and reverse M&A-style structures—to secure technical funding and resource offsets from platform partners.
  • Manage executive stakeholder relationships at partner organizations, building long-term alliances that generate recurring technical investment.
  • Conduct technical demonstrations and present compelling business cases to secure JTP commitments from partner organizations.
  • Monitor emerging trends in AI, AdTech, and data infrastructure to surface new opportunities that align partner priorities with Nova's roadmap.

Reporting, Pacing & Commercial Operations

  • Own end-to-end commercial deal management: sourcing, structuring, executing, and reporting on all commercial partner agreements.
  • Track and communicate pacing toward commercial revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, flagging risks and opportunities in real time.
  • Manage the distribution and re-investment of commercial deal value back to the appropriate business units (product, activation, sales/marketing, partnerships, etc.).
  • Define and maintain measurable OKRs and KPIs for all active commercial partnerships, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.

Program Management & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the sole internal champion for partner pilots, incentive programs, and commercial initiatives—owning the full program lifecycle from kickoff to post-delivery reporting.
  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product, and CX to ensure partner programs are fully resourced and successfully executed.
  • Act as the primary bridge between external partners and Power Digital's internal teams, managing timelines, escalations, and stakeholder communication throughout.
  • Build feedback loops from the delivery team back to partners to demonstrate performance, reinforce trust, and identify expansion opportunities.

Co-Marketing & Brand Amplification

  • Identify and secure speaking opportunities at partner-hosted events, industry conferences, and co-produced webinars—positioning Power Digital and fusepoint SMEs as thought leaders within the partner ecosystem.
  • Develop and pitch joint content opportunities with technology partners, including whitepapers, case studies, blog features, social campaigns, and co-branded research that expand reach and reinforce credibility.
  • Build and maintain a rolling co-marketing pipeline with priority partners—proactively sourcing opportunities tied to FusePoint's consulting capabilities, Nova's technology story, and Power Digital's broader service offering.
  • Coordinate with the internal marketing team to brief, scope, and execute co-marketing initiatives—ensuring partner needs are properly resourced and launched on time.
  • Pitch and secure sponsorship and activation opportunities for partners to participate in Power Digital summits, client dinners, and co-hosted events.
  • Leverage the partner ecosystem to facilitate introductions and build relationships between priority technology partners and Power Digital's CX team—creating direct lines of support that drive client retention, upsell opportunities, and deeper platform utilization across the book of business.

Role Requirements:

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or GTM roles—ideally within a marketing agency, AdTech, SaaS, or consulting environment.
  • Proven track record of owning and closing complex commercial agreements, including co-sell, resell, or technology partnership structures.
  • Experience with enterprise fundraising motions, joint business planning, or financial modeling
  • Deep understanding of the AdTech and MarTech landscape, including platforms such as Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon, Snowflake, Klaviyo, Shopify, or similar.
  • Strong analytical skills—comfortable building financial models, interpreting performance data, and synthesizing market intelligence into partner strategy.
  • Excellent executive presence and presentation skills; able to command the room with both internal leadership and senior partner stakeholders.
  • Experience working cross-functionally across marketing, sales, product, and CX teams to drive shared outcomes.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across large, matrixed organizations.
  • Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to secure high-value deals and investment commitments.
  • Self-starter mentality—comfortable operating with ambiguity and building programs from the ground up.

Strategic Thinking

    • Innovative mindset; actively identifies creative partnership structures and commercial opportunities others miss.
    • Results-oriented with a bias toward measurable impact over activity.
    • Ability to zoom between macro strategy and detailed execution without losing sight of either.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Total commercial revenue sourced from partner ecosystem
  • Joint technical/ innovation revenue secured for nova annually
  • Fusepoint revenue sourced from partner ecosystem
  • Client Retention and Growth influenced by GTM/ commercial partnerships

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Commercial Execution: Own and close complex commercial deals across JBP, JTP, co-sell, resell, and incentive programs—translating partner relationships into measurable revenue and resource value for Power Digital.
  • Nova Technical Partnerships: Lead the enterprise fundraising motion tied to Nova—building the business case, managing executive relationships at partner organizations, and securing technical funding and offsets aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Fusepoint Partnership Development: Build a distinct portfolio of consulting-focused technology partnerships that give Fusepoint exclusive testing access, credentialing opportunities, and a competitive edge in the market.
  • Program Management: Champion every partner initiative internally—from pilot launch to post-delivery reporting—ensuring no deal goes dark, and every partner program delivers on its commercial promise.
  • Partner Co-Marketing & Visibility: Identify and secure speaking opportunities, joint content, and co-branded activations with technology partners that expand Power Digital's and FusePoint's reach, reinforce thought leadership, and drive revenue potential through the partner ecosystem.
  • Client Retention & Growth via Partners: Leverage the partner ecosystem to build direct relationships between technology partners and the CX team—turning partner connections into a lever for client retention, upsell, and deeper platform adoption across the book of business.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited PTO (available on day one)
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • 12 observed national holidays—including Juneteenth

jobs.description:
Employment Type: Full-TimeWork Setting: In-office/Remote
Work Location: United States/RemoteWork Hours: Office hours
Find out more here:

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

SemiAnalysis is seeking an AI Infrastructure Credit Research Analyst to lead our coverage of how the global AI infrastructure buildout is financed.

This role will examine who is providing capital, how financing arrangements are structured, the terms attached to that capital, and where the underlying financial risk ultimately sits. The analysis will combine SemiAnalysis’s proprietary datacenter and semiconductor supply chain data with detailed balance-sheet, credit, and financial intermediation research.

The successful candidate will build the firm’s coverage of AI infrastructure credit from the ground up, producing definitive research for credit investors, limited partners, financial institutions, regulators, and other market participants.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze the full financing stack supporting the AI infrastructure buildout, including:

    • Hyperscalers balance sheets

    • Neoclouds and AI cloud debt

    • GPU-backed lending

    • Datacenter asset-backed securities

    • Project finance

    • Private credit funds

    • Business development companies

    • Special-purpose vehicles

    • Vendor financing arrangements

  • Map financing relationships across the AI ecosystem, identifying:

    • Who is lending to whom

    • The terms and maturity profiles of the financing

    • The structures through which capital is provided

    • The parties ultimately holding the credit and asset risk

  • Build quantitative models to assess credit risk across AI infrastructure investments.

  • Evaluate counterparty exposure, concentration risk, and dependencies across borrowers, lenders, investors, equipment vendors, and infrastructure providers.

  • Model the value and resilience of collateral, including:

    • GPU depreciation and residual value

    • Power purchase agreements

    • Datacenter leases

    • Capacity contracts

    • Equipment financing arrangements

  • Analyze interest-rate sensitivity, refinancing requirements, maturity walls, covenant structures, and liquidity risks.

  • Develop downside and stress scenarios to assess how weaker demand, declining hardware values, delayed construction, power constraints, or tighter financial conditions could affect borrowers and lenders.

  • Track the migration of lending activity from regulated banks to nonbank financial institutions.

  • Assess how the growth of private credit and nonbank lending changes where financial risk is concentrated and how losses could spread during a downturn.

  • Produce flagship research reports and recurring coverage on AI infrastructure financing and credit markets.

  • Build proprietary datasets from bank reports, fund filings, corporate disclosures, securitization documents, loan agreements, and other financial sources.

  • Work closely with SemiAnalysis’s datacenter, semiconductor, energy, and supply chain teams to ensure financial analysis is grounded in what is physically being built, contracted, delivered, and energized.

  • Present research findings to clients and represent SemiAnalysis’s credit views through public writing, meetings, podcasts, conferences, and other industry discussions.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in credit markets, banking, financial intermediation, structured finance, or related areas.

  • Relevant background may include:

    • Bachelors' Degree in financial economics or a related discipline

    • Sell-side credit or macroeconomic research

    • Buy-side credit research

    • Central bank or financial stability research

    • Private credit or structured finance experience

    • Equivalent professional research experience

  • Strong understanding of corporate, bank, and investment fund balance sheets.

  • Ability to independently interpret complex financial documents, including:

    • Bank call reports

    • Corporate filings

    • Fund and BDC disclosures

    • Asset-backed securities documentation

    • Credit agreements

    • Project finance structures

    • Special-purpose vehicle documentation

  • Strong credit judgement and the ability to identify hidden leverage, off-balance-sheet exposure, weak collateral, refinancing risk, and structural subordination.

  • Strong empirical and quantitative skills, including the ability to build original datasets and analytical models.

  • Ability to validate assumptions, defend methodologies, and clearly explain the limitations of available data.

  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, rigorous research for a demanding professional audience.

  • Ability to work accurately and efficiently under publication deadlines.

  • High level of intellectual independence and willingness to publish conclusions that may differ from prevailing market views.

Preferred Skills

  • Research or investment experience covering:

    • Private credit

    • Nonbank financial institutions

    • Leveraged finance

    • Structured credit

    • Asset-backed securities

    • Project finance

    • Financial stability

    • Bank and nonbank intermediation

  • Understanding of how financial intermediation has evolved since the 2008 global financial crisis.

  • Named authorship on published research from a:

    • Sell-side research team

    • Central bank

    • Bank economics team

    • International Monetary Fund

    • Bank for International Settlements

    • Policy or financial research institution

  • Experience analyzing interest rates and the transmission of monetary policy into lending standards, credit availability, asset values, and refinancing conditions.

  • Familiarity with datacenters, semiconductor economics, AI infrastructure, or power markets.

  • Experience analyzing infrastructure financing structures or capital-intensive technology investment cycles.

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel, or other tools used for financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience working with large, fragmented, or difficult-to-structure financial datasets.

  • Strong presentation and client communication skills.

Growth Areas

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Define SemiAnalysis’s AI infrastructure credit and financing coverage from the ground up.

  • Become a leading industry voice on how the AI buildout is financed and where the associated financial risks are concentrated.

  • Build proprietary credit datasets using SemiAnalysis’s unique information on datacenter construction, power availability, accelerator shipments, hardware deployments, and supply chain activity.

  • Develop original risk frameworks for emerging financing structures such as GPU-backed lending, neoclouds debt, private credit facilities, and AI infrastructure securitizations.

  • Expand coverage into adjacent areas such as:

    • Datacenter project finance

    • Energy infrastructure financing

    • Structured credit

    • Financial stability

    • Private market leverage

You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.
