Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a motivated Knowledge Center Tier I Agent (Junior) to analyze and resolve support requests from the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the Knowledge Center by toll-free phone, support email, public web form, and public chatbot; the agent determines what the user needs and how urgent it is, creates and manages the ticket on the user's behalf, resolves common account, access, and navigation issues using documented procedures, and decides when to escalate. Every ticket follows the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This is a primarily remote position and an excellent entry point into Federal IT customer support. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Analyze inbound external-user requests from the toll-free line, support email, public web form, and chatbot handoffs to determine the application, nature, business impact, and Priority Level, and create complete, accurate tickets in the Government's ITSM system on the user's behalf.
  • Determine the resolution approach for common Tier I external-user issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications using knowledge articles and documented procedures, and decide when escalation to the KC Escalation Coordinator is required.
  • Manage external-user communication through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and safeguard sensitive user information in accordance with Privacy Act and CUI requirements.
  • Analyze incoming incidents and service requests from internal users across phone, chat, email, and portal channels to determine the nature, scope, and business impact of each issue, and independently assign the appropriate Priority Level (PL1 through PL4) and category in the enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Determine the appropriate resolution approach for each Tier I issue by evaluating symptoms against known errors, knowledge articles, and system behavior, and decide when an issue can be resolved at Tier I, deflected to self-service, or must be escalated to Tier II, Tier III, or a specialized resolver group.
  • Resolve account, access, connectivity, and application issues by selecting and applying the correct diagnostic and remediation steps, including administrative actions on user accounts and configurations within delegated authority.
  • Evaluate whether resolution actions have fully addressed the customer's need before placing tickets in "Resolved - Awaiting Customer Confirmation" status under the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and document resolutions clearly for reuse by other analysts.
  • Assess the age and risk of items in the open ticket queue, decide which require follow-up with users or resolver groups, and take action to prevent tickets from breaching resolution SLAs.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 0 years of related experience (an Associate's degree with 2 years of related experience, or 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Experience or demonstrated aptitude in help desk, service desk, call center, desktop support, or customer technical support.
  • Working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 applications, Active Directory account concepts, basic networking (Wi-Fi, VPN, IP connectivity), and common peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and service desk workflows, including accurate ticket documentation and escalation.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts (evenings, overnight, weekends, and holidays) if assigned to the extended-hours team.
  • Strong customer service orientation, patience, and the ability to communicate clearly with non-technical users by phone and in writing.
  • Ability to follow documented procedures precisely while handling a high volume of contacts in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience or demonstrated aptitude supporting external customers or the public through phone, email, and web channels; ability to work assigned shifts within 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET; this position primarily works remotely.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • HDI Customer Service Representative, HDI Support Center Analyst, or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Experience using ServiceNow (incident, request, knowledge, CMDB, Service Catalog, Virtual Agent) or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
  • Experience working across multiple security enclaves (NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS) and with classified system handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with customer experience (CX) measurement, including CSAT, Customer Effort Score (CES), and experience level agreements (XLAs).
  • Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or other compliance-driven Federal IT environments.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and mobile device basics.
  • Interest in growing into Tier II desktop support, systems administration, or cybersecurity roles.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.


This is a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) role in the CTIO team that delivers the cutting edge innovation for our sensor (lightweight agent) for Linux, Windows, and Mac OS platforms. The SDE’s in the team own design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Linux, Windows, and MacOS. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.


The CTIO team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.


What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
  • Conceptualize and develop new product features.
  • Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
  • Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
  • Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

What You’ll Need:

  • Deep knowledge of C/C++.
  • Extensive understanding of Linux OS internals.
  • Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light-weight, and highly performing systems
  • In-depth OS system expertise regarding core concepts and subsystems

  • Knowledge of security principles

Job Summary

Job Summary:

Location: 100% remote (US only), supporting VA medical centers in VISN 7 Term: 12-month base period plus four 12-month option periods. Pay: 25.00/hr-30.00/hr

About the role

Aptive Resources is looking for experienced coding auditors to run external coding audits for Veterans Affairs medical centers in Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina. You'll audit inpatient DRG, outpatient, and professional fee coding, report what you find, and teach VA coding staff and clinicians how to improve. The VA expects about 5,000 audited records a year across the Atlanta, Birmingham, Columbia, and Augusta facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

What you'll do

  • Audit coded data for accuracy and compliance, separately from the regular coding work. Each audit focuses on one area: inpatient facility (DRG), outpatient facility, inpatient professional services including surgery, or outpatient services (urgent care, clinic visits, and ambulatory surgery).
  • Review up to the first 25 diagnoses and the first 25 procedures on each record, for both facility and professional services.
  • Help build statistically valid samples (a 95% confidence level, and at least 10% of records) and data collection tools for each audit.
  • Review each facility's HIMS policies and coding procedures before the audit starts.
  • Classify errors as coding, diagnosis, modifier, documentation, or compliance errors, and back up each one with coding references.
  • Write facility audit reports covering accuracy, financial impact, and areas of concern, and contribute to a network-wide report.
  • Go over draft findings with the HIMS Chief, COR, and facility leaders within 7 business days of the audit, and deliver final reports within 15 business days.
  • Create facility-specific training plans, and lead "train the trainer" education sessions of at least 2 hours, using real charts, for coding staff, managers, and physicians.
  • Run exit conferences with Health Information Management leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • An active RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, or CPC-H credential.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a consultant reviewing records for large tertiary care hospitals and outpatient organizations that cover all subspecialties and primary care.
  • At least 3 years of education and training experience, such as teaching coders or providers.
  • At least 3 years of coding experience.
  • Two current client references who can speak to your audit work. These are submitted with the contract proposal.
  • Proof of active credentials, plus a current resume for the proposal.
  • Completion of an accredited coding, HIM, or health information technician program.
  • Expertise in ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, DRG/MS-DRG, APC, E/M, and NCCI edits.
  • US citizenship, and the ability to pass a federal background investigation (NACI) and fingerprinting.

Preferred qualifications

  • An auditing credential such as CDIP, CPMA, or CIC, in addition to a required credential.
  • Experience auditing for the VA or another federal health system.
  • Strong report writing and presentation skills, including explaining findings in plain language for non-coders.

Additional requirements

  • Complete the VA's annual Privacy and Information Security Awareness and HIPAA training (TMS 10176 and 10203).
  • Travel to VA facilities only when the government authorizes it. Approved travel is reimbursed under federal travel regulations.

About Aptive

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.

Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

About Argano

Argano is a global specialist consultancy and the High-Performance Operations partner to mid-market and large enterprises. We combine deep, practitioner-level industry expertise with connected capability across the platforms that run modern operations — Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks and more — to help clients turn technology, data, and AI into measurable operational results. Clients choose Argano for boutique-quality delivery at enterprise scale: the business-problem-first thinking of a specialist with the breadth and reliability to execute across a heterogeneous technology estate.

The Opportunity

Industry analysts shape how buyers, publishers, and private-equity sponsors perceive the services market. As Argano moves from a collection of acquired practices into one unified operating model, we need a single, credible owner of our relationships with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, HFS, ISG, and the other firms that rank and evaluate our space.

The Director, Analyst Relations will build and run Argano’s analyst relations program from the ground up: the engagement strategy, the operating cadence, the executive preparation, the evaluation and RFI submissions, and the loop that brings analyst research and market insight back into our business units and go-to-market. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set the strategy and also personally drive the briefing calendar, the submission tracker, and the executive prep deck.

You will report to the SVP of Marketing and work daily with Argano’s CEO, Chief Growth Officer, Presidents, business-unit and practice leaders, and the corporate marketing, communications, and demand-generation teams.

Analyst engagement strategy

  • Build, own, and continuously refine a multi-year analyst relations strategy that supports Argano’s corporate and business-unit growth priorities — including which firms, analysts, and evaluations matter most, and why.

  • Map the analyst landscape across our publisher practices (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks), our offerings (AI, Connect, Managed Services, HCM, Supply Chain, Revenue Operations), and our priority verticals (healthcare and life sciences, pharma, manufacturing, homebuilding, wholesale and distribution).

  • Recommend and manage analyst firm relationships and subscriptions, including scope, budget, renewals, and inquiry usage, so the company gets measurable value from every contract.

  • Define and report the KPIs for the program — inclusion and placement in key evaluations, briefing volume and quality, analyst sentiment, referenced mentions in research, inquiry usage, and analyst-influenced pipeline.

Evaluations, RFIs, and report submissions

  • Own the calendar of Magic Quadrants, Waves, MarketScapes, PEAK Matrix assessments, Horizons reports, Provider Lens studies, and other evaluations relevant to Argano; decide where we participate and manage the end-to-end response.

  • Prepare and coach executives and practice leaders for evaluation demos and briefings, and manage post-evaluation fact-checks, reviews, and debriefs.

  • Maintain a reusable library of company facts, proof points, case studies, metrics, and boilerplate so every submission is consistent, current, and on-message.

Briefings, inquiries, and executive preparation

  • Run a proactive briefing and inquiry program: secure the right analyst meetings, set objectives, build the narrative and materials, and follow up on commitments.

  • Prepare Argano executives ahead of every analyst interaction with concise briefing documents covering the analyst’s coverage, recent research, prior interactions, likely questions, and our key messages.

Voice of the market into the business

Program operations

  • Establish the operating rhythm for the program: the annual plan, the quarterly review with executive leadership, briefing and submission calendars, and a reporting dashboard.

  • Manage analyst relations budget, agency or contractor support, and analyst firm contracts.

  • Ensure compliance with each analyst firm’s citation, quotation, and reprint policies, and with Argano’s brand and communications standards.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5–7+ years of experience in analyst relations, or a closely related mix of analyst relations, public relations, product marketing, or corporate communications, with demonstrated ownership of analyst programs and evaluations.

  • Direct working experience with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, HFS, ISG, or comparable firms, including managing Magic Quadrant, Wave, PEAK Matrix, or similar evaluation submissions from start to finish.

  • Strong understanding of the technology and professional services market, ideally within consulting, systems integration, managed services, or enterprise software.

  • Excellent executive-facing communication skills; able to distill complex research into crisp briefs and coach senior leaders with confidence and tact.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a private-equity-backed or acquisitive company through brand and operating-model integration.

jobs.description:
Artemis Connection is a strategic management consultancy working across the for-profit, public and social sectors. We help clients around the world identify their most pressing strategic issues and we staff teams of strategy consultants to roll up their sleeves and deliver impact. We are passionate about helping innovative and entrepreneurial leaders reach their goals through a customized project-based approach, typically focused around:

  • Bespoke Innovation, Sales, and Marketing Strategy
  • Purpose-driven Transformation
  • Embedded Strategy and Operations roles

Our founder is Christy Johnson, an entrepreneur, educator, and former McKinsey Engagement Manager. Our advisors include HR officers, executive coaches, academics, entrepreneurs, and neuroscientists. Our team is made up of seasoned consultants, trained at organizations such as McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain, Big 4 Strategy, and elite educational institutions.

What makes Artemis Connection unique is the opportunity to combine this first-rate consulting experience with the flexibility that many other consulting firms don’t offer. In short, we’re a consulting firm for experienced top-tier consultants who still want to deliver exemplary value for clients but who need more flexibility in their professional and personal lives. Specifically, we’re flexible with where you want to work and how many hours you want to work – meaning no rigid expectations of being at the client every day, living in a certain city, or clocking in a full 50 hours (or more) each week, whilst still delivering exceptional results for our clients.

Currently, our team members are spread across the country, engaging with clients remotely (occasionally on-site, as client needs dictate) and working varied hours (ranging from 10 hours/week to 55 hours/week). We offer market-rate compensation based on the outcomes that you deliver and the number of hours and weeks that you will be leading project work, plus bonuses for bringing in new clients.

Given our flexible structure and smaller size, we tend to bring on new team members in a “trial-to-hire” capacity. In other words, we initially hire individuals as independent contractorsfor discrete client projects, and then, after successful projects completion and mutual determination of “fit”, we may move towards a more permanent employment arrangement.

To learn more about Artemis Connection, visit.

Engagement Manager Position

We’re looking for experienced strategy consultants to serve as Engagement Managers on our team. (This role is roughly equivalent to an Engagement Manager at McKinsey, a Project Leader at BCG, or a Manager at Bain).

Our ideal candidate has successfully led client engagement work at a top consulting firm and is looking to continue that work in the flexible consulting model that Artemis Connection provides. She/He is a strategic thinker, structured communicator, and excellent project manager who can navigate between managing client teams and more junior Artemis Connection team members. (As such, we’re also open to candidates with in-house strategy/operations experience, if that experience has built this consulting “toolkit” of skills).

Responsibilities

The role of the Engagement Manager is to own the entire life cycleof a consulting engagement, leading the day-to-day work, managing teams of 1-6, managing upwards to engage ‘Principals’ or Senior Advisors on the team, and excellent at managing client relationships.

Pre-project preparation
Please note that pre-project activities are not compensated, as they are intended to prepare you to lead the project. It is seen as an investment you will make to start building the client trust and have more control over the scope and direction of the project.

  • Support in proposal development for a potential project you may lead if it translates into an active project
  • Participate in final business development meetings with clients to ensure that the project is scoped well and that you are able to build a strong relationship with the client from the start

Own end-to-end project delivery

  • Identify the client’s most pressing strategic issues, develop hypotheses to prove during client engagement, and communicate (then re-communicate) these issues/hypotheses to both clients and case team members as the case evolves
  • Create and maintain a project team work plan to diagnose and resolve the client’s strategic issues, including data-driven analyses, client engagements, and delivery of recommendations
  • Ensure all client deliverables are aligned with the client, and executed in a high-quality and timely way

Team Management

  • Manage teams of 1-6, providing regular coaching and input on their workstreams
  • Ensuring that team members are assigned to the highest value work, resulting in an on-budget, on-time project
  • Lead the day-to-day work of team members (e.g., structuring their analyses, reviewing their deliverables, providing on-the-job coaching)

Manage client relationships

  • Build trustworthy, transparent, and collaborative relationships with senior executives and other key contacts at client organizations
  • Facilitate client engagement in case team work, including organising client meetings and workshops, making decisions with clients at key points during case, and transitioning end-of-case recommendations or implementation plan
  • Identify opportunities for additional client work, either through follow-on work with existing clients or through potential engagements with new clients

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years Consulting experience,ideally from a top-tier firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain), though in-house strategy/operations experience also considered
  • Track record of coaching clients to measurable outcomes required
  • Track record of coaching case teams (or sideways managing / informally influencing others) to measurable outcomes also required
  • Demonstrated skills in project management required, ideally in a “case team” or “client service” type of environment
  • Demonstrated skills in effective communication, including ability to build senior client relationships and effective case team relationships, required
  • Commitment to producing high-quality, client-ready work, on tight timelines, required
  • Orientation toward being a proactive, curious team member
  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel required, in order to coach other team members on these tools
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree preferred

Other expectations

  • Ability to thrive in a remote work environment, leading team members to collaborate in a way that ensures the best client and team experience
  • Minimum time commitment of 20 hours per week
  • Willing to travel: client travel requests are typically light, as needed for client interactions

jobs.description:
Who We Are

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We’re in our clients’ Slacks, we’re on a first-name basis with them (and their pets), we’re new hires’ first point of contact, and we’re the first stop for tech and cybersecurity issues. We aim to build trust, and we leverage this to keep the bad actors out.

Some of the biggest names in the progressive space have leaned on us as their trusted IT + cybersecurity partner. We are looking for top IT talent as we continue to scale our team.

About the Role

Personified is looking for a Senior Vice President of Technology to run the operational core of our technology organization: engineering, client support, cybersecurity, and IT operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run these functions inside a managed service provider before and knows exactly what breaks at scale: ticket queues, on-call rotations, security posture, tooling debt, and how to fix it without slowing the team down.

You'll report to the CTO and own execution across four functional leaders and the day-to-day delivery. You are the person who makes sure the trains run on time, the team is accountable, and our 97% client retention rate stays exactly where it is, or gets better.

This role exists because Personified is growing past the point where one person can run every function directly. We need someone who has done this before, who can walk into a room of client support engineers or a security incident and immediately know what questions to ask.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Support & Service Delivery — Ensure the team hits our response-time and resolution standards across every client tier. Own escalation paths, staffing models, and the systems (like our Halo ticketing platform) that keep support predictable and measurable.
  • Engineering — Oversee infrastructure, systems engineering, and technical delivery. Set standards for process discipline, documentation, and accountability across the engineering team.
  • Cybersecurity — Own the operational security posture across our client base: monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance readiness. Make sure security isn't a side conversation — it's built into how we operate.
  • IT Operations — Drive the shift from manual, reactive IT operations toward automation and repeatable processes. Reduce the operational load on the team while improving consistency for clients.
  • People leadership — Directly manage functional leaders across these four areas. Set clear expectations, run a real performance management cadence, and build a bench of leaders under you who can eventually run without your direct involvement.
  • Cross-functional operations — Be the connective tissue between functions that too often operate in silos. When a client issue touches support, engineering, and security at once, you're the person who makes sure it gets resolved as one coordinated response, not three separate ones.
  • Metrics and accountability — Build and own the operational scorecard for technology delivery: response times, resolution rates, security incidents, retention impact. Bring data, not anecdotes, to every conversation with the CTO.
  • Travel or work or present onsite as needed to support business needs, ensure continuity of service, and represent Personified to our clients and partners at the highest level.

Skills + Experience

  • 8+ years in technology operations leadership, with at least 4 in a managed service provider (MSP) environment, you understand ticket economics, SLAs, multi-client environments, and the specific pressure of supporting many organizations at once rather than one.
  • Direct people-management experience across multiple technical functions simultaneously (not just one discipline). You've managed managers, not just individual contributors.
  • A track record of taking an under-disciplined operation and making it measurably more consistent, without making it slower or more bureaucratic.
  • Real fluency in cybersecurity operations; you don't need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you need to know enough to ask sharp questions and hold a security leader accountable.
  • Experience building or scaling IT automation — you should be able to speak concretely about a time you replaced manual process with something repeatable.
  • A communication style that is direct and specific. You document decisions. You don't let vague problems stay vague.

What Would Make You a Great Fit Here

  • You've worked with or served mission-driven, nonprofit, or advocacy organizations before, and you understand why 'the client hired us so they never have to think about IT again' is a real design principle, not a slogan.
  • You're comfortable in a smaller, fast-moving company where your title doesn't insulate you from doing real work.
  • You believe good process makes teams faster, not slower, and you can tell the difference between bureaucracy and discipline.
  • You want to build a team, not just manage one that already exists.

Reporting Structure

This role has direct management authority over the functional leaders in Client Support, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IT Operations. It reports to the CTO, who retains direct ownership of Technical Programs and Training/Content, along with technology strategy, senior-level accountability, and cross-company initiatives.

Benefits

  • Healthcare packages contributed to by Personified

  • Annual learning & development stipend

This role serves as both a sales manager and individual contributor, responsible for achieving assigned revenue objectives while coaching and developing a team of sales professionals.


The ideal candidate brings a consultative approach to business development, a deep understanding of healthcare marketing challenges, and the ability to position digital agency services as strategic investments to buying committees.


Essential Responsibilities:

  • Own and achieve revenue targets for assigned digital marketing services through a consultative sales approach focused on solving client business challenges.

  • Develop and cultivate relationships with hospital and health system decision-makers, including marketing, communications, digital, strategy, physician outreach, and executive leadership stakeholders.
  • Actively prospect and build relationships through industry networking, conferences, client engagement, and other business development activities.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales professionals, providing guidance in prospecting strategy, account planning, pipeline management, discovery, proposal development, and closing activities.
  • Foster a high-performance sales culture through consistent coaching, accountability, performance measurement, and professional development.
  • Monitor pipeline health, forecast accuracy, sales activity, and performance metrics to ensure achievement of individual and team objectives.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support opportunity qualification, solution design, proposal development, pricing, contracting, and implementation readiness.
  • Serve as a liaison between clients and IQVIA operational, product, and service delivery teams to ensure successful transitions from sale to implementation.

  • 10+ years of successful sales, account management, or business development experience, with a minimum of 3 years in sales leadership or people management responsibilities.

  • Strong understanding of hospital and health system market dynamics, including marketing, service line growth, and referral development.
  • Must have successful experience identifying and closing new business opportunities while developing positive relationships at all levels of client management and within IQVIA sales, consulting, and marketing teams.

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

jobs.excerpt: The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks.
jobs.description:
The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks. At Augintel, we build Natural Language Processing (NLP) software that helps social workers and clinicians read through mountains of messy case notes to find critical, life-saving information about kids and families.

Our tool can help a social worker understand a thousand-page case history in seconds. Because of our software, caseworkers are finding lost grandmothers so kids don't go to foster care, uncovering hidden risks, and quickly spotting if a child urgently needs diabetes medication.
We are a small, tight-knit team of five, and we need a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the infrastructure that makes this all possible.

What You Will Actually Do Here: We need you to build the heavy-lifting software around the AI. You will be working closely with a Machine Learning expert.

  • The Heavy Lifting (70%): The biggest chunk of your work will be building the engine that extracts insights from notes and indexes them for downstream consumers (APIs, our web app). This will entail designing and building pipelines that process millions of case notes reliably and at scale. This backend work is heavily driven by Python.
  • The Infrastructure: You will be configuring and using AWS (specifically ECS, OpenSearch, Lambda, and S3) and writing solid SQL (we use PostgreSQL).
  • The Web App (30%): The remaining portion of your work will involve the front-end user interface and APIs, where you will use TypeScript (React and NodeJS).

Who You Are:

  • You have 5+ years of real-world experience. We are looking for someone who is solidly mid-level (your second or third real job). You aren't an entry-level beginner, but you also aren't looking to be a hands-off architect or on a fast track to management. You just want to write great code and improve your craft.
  • You are independent. We are a remote team. We need someone who can work on their couch, figure things out, and know when to raise their hand for help without flailing.
  • You like talking to people. You will occasionally jump on video calls directly with our clients to troubleshoot issues, stand up new features, or whiteboard solutions. We don't want someone who just wants to sit in a dark closet and write code.
  • You want ownership. You won't just be blindly pulling widgets off a backlog. You will collaborate daily with our ML researcher, product manager, and clients to frame problems and design actual solutions.

The Perks:

  • 100% Remote (US-based). If you happen to be in the Chicago area, great—we have a local nexus here—but it is absolutely not required.
  • Get hands-on experience working right alongside cutting-edge Machine Learning and NLP technology.
  • Go to sleep every night knowing your code is actively keeping kids safe and giving social workers their time back.

If you are a solid Python, Typescript and AWS developer who wants to use your powers for good, we want to talk to you.

jobs.excerpt: Would you enjoy working with cutting-edge web security systems?
jobs.description:
Would you enjoy working with cutting-edge web security systems?

Does the opportunity to make a difference at a leading technology organization excite you?

Join our Micro Segmentation Professional Services team

With our cutting-edge technology, we are changing the way organizations protect their most critical assets in their data center and cloud environments. Our team is responsible for implementing network segmentation projects for our strategic customers, using our Guardicore Micro Segmentation product. We collaborate with customers and prospects to align our solutions to business needs.

Partner with our enterprise customers

You will design, plan and drive the implementation of segmentation projects for large enterprises. You will work closely with customers to manage projects, provide creative solutions, and develop successful implementations.

As a Senior II Security Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the planning, installation and integration of the Guardicore product in diverse infrastructure environments
  • Working with customers throughout a delivery project life cycle from project management and architecture design to installation, configuration and documentation
  • Deploying and implementing network segmentation policies using our state of the art segmentation platform
  • Delivering advanced professional services (such as customizations / training / expansions / configurations / optimizations)
  • Working closely with Support and Engineering teams to quickly resolve any client issues and drive customer post-sales satisfaction

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 8 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree or its equivalent
  • Have experience deploying, configuring and troubleshooting software or networking equipment
  • Have in-depth knowledge in Networking, Operating Systems and Data Center Infrastructure
  • Demonstrate the ability to be proactive with a keen desire to learn
  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills and are not afraid to challenge expectations and perceptions
  • Demonstrate skills in network or endpoint security platforms, scripting (Bash, Python)
  • Have a history working with large enterprises and can talk about leading major successful projects

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $139,300 - $250,700/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.
